tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog 'bring po rdo rje'i me dbal gyi glog phreng bdud dpung zil gnon bzhugs so// na maḥshrī badz+ra ku mā rā ya/ 'od gsal dbyings las khro bo'i sku/ /rnam 'phrul bde chen 'gyur med gsung / /zung 'jug brjod bral rdo rje'i thugs/ /lhag pa'i lha der rab btud nas/ /de yi phrin las mngon spyod kyi/ /las mtha' drag po'i cho ga la/ /brten nas dgra bgegs kun 'joms pa'i/ /gsal byed rin chen phreng 'di spel/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor ma'i cho gas pha rol gyi gnod pa bzlog tshul cung zad brjod na/ don gsum ste/ sbyor ba brten dang yo byad bshams pa/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul/ rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs phyag bdar dang / yi dam chos skyong sogs kyi rten bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun du mchod gtor sman raka bsham ste/ sgrub pa po'i mdun du chos 'byung mthing nag che chung ji ltar 'tshams pa'i dbus su 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar gru gsum mthing nag kha khyer ༈ ljang khu la rdo rjes mtshan pa/༈ zla gam dmar po/ dbus su rdo rje chos 'byung gi rtse mo ngos su pad nyi'i gdan bri ༈ sngon po kha gdeng pa bri/ 'khor lo'i bar rnams phyogs mdog༈ nam mkha'i mdog ces pa'ang bya/ de'i khar mañdzi'i steng dugatso bo'i gtor ma zur gsum pa la khro bo bcu'i gtor mas bskor ba dang / chos 'byung gi rtse mo lhor bstan pa'i ngos su shwa na ma/ de'i lhor bdud rgyal gi gtor ma la dar nag btsugs pa/ nub byang gi zur du sa bdag mo/ byang shar du bdag nyid ma rnams kyi gtor ma zur gsum pa la mtshe dang yungs dkar gyi sgang bu/ skyer rtsang la sogs pas lag len bzhin brgyan pa'i mthar chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga/

mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog rnams 'khor mar bshams/ gzhan yang de'i mtha' skor du liṅga che ba gcig la chung ba bcus bskor ba snod gcig tu gzhag la/ liṅga che ba'i ske la sngo dmar gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i rtse mor phur bu btags te bzhag pa dang / thun rdzas kyi yungs dkar nag lcags zangs rdo phye khrag thun thod par blugs pa/ mda' zor dug shing gi mde'u can la hūm̐ bh+yoḥphaṭa rnams bris pa dang / rdo zor dur khrod kyi rdo la sngags gong bzhin bris pa gnyis ka dug khrag gis byugs pa/ rwa zor byed na glang ngam/ g.yag 'bras bu yod pa'i rwa g.yas kyi nang du dug khrag blugs pa'i kha re ba nag pos bcad/ skyer pa'i phur pa dang tshon skud kyis kha bcing ba rnams 'dus byas/ liṅga'i rgyu ni bag zan la byas/ ra thug gi gcin/ lug thug gi chu/ gad pa chad pa'i sa/ phung shul gyi sa rnams la bya'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa rnams gral la 'khod pa'i mdun du rdo rje dril bu/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru/ rnga cha lang / bsnyen phur/ 'og tu dgos pa'i gdab phur bcu bdun/ de rnams la mthu bskyed pa'i yungs dkar gu gul sogs bshams la/ rdo rje'i rtses mchod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ sa lo'i bka' 'bum na bh+rūṃ las zhes snang /༈ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang drag po'i gzhal yas khang mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du a las bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod yangs shing rgya che bar dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag gi a dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi sgrol me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling thod rnga la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyi mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig

oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe ā hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke༞ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe༞ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye༞ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta༞ oṃ badz+ra u da pha la hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra bi pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/༈ sa lo'i bka' 'bum na bi pu ra 'di snang / ces brjod la rnga byin dbab rgyas 'bring bsdus pa skabs dang bstun pa bgyis nas/ /gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i tshul ni/ rang gi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs chos srung nor lha dang bcas pa mngon sum lta bur bzhugs par mos nas/ skyabs 'gro khyad par bzhi gzhan nas 'byung ba bzhin gsal btab la ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba khams gsum nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus de nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la༞ dam pa'i chos rnams༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams༞ zhes pa nyer gcig tsam byas la/ de nas/ rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas la/ /dus gsum bzhugs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchog gsum bstan pa'i gzhir gyur pa/ /gnyis med yid kyis skyabs su mchi/ /dngos 'byor yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i/ /dag pa'i mchod pa bzhes su gsol/ /dngos grub chu bo gcod pa'i bgegs/ /nyes byas ma lus bshags par bgyi/ /phyogs bcu 'khor gsum dag pa'i chos/ /ma chags spyod la rjes yi rangs/ /dag pa'i mtha' bzhi dri ma med/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems bskyed do/ /bde gshegs byang chub sems dpa' la/

/dgos pa gsum gyis lus 'bul lo/ /tshe rabs bgrangs ba'i las rnams kun/ /bsdus te byang chub chen por bsngo/ /sems can bde dang ldan gyur cig /sdug bsngal dag dang bral bar shog /bde dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing / /chos kun mnyam nyid rtogs par shog /ces brjod do/ gnyis pa ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ phyi nang snod bcud kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad stong pa nyid du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsgom mo/ /gnyis pa mtshams bcad pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi sems nyi ma'i steng du yi ge hūm̐ du gyur/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas 'od zer spros bsdus pas/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de 'od du zhu bas rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa lte bar yi ge hūm̐ dang bcas par gyur/ hūm̐ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ sna g.yas nas thon/ mdun du hūm̐ sgril ma gcig tu gyur/ badz+ra dh+rīka ces brjod pas/ hūm̐ gcig bye rang la thim pas rang zhe sdang rdo rje'i skur gyur pa sku mdog mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa zhal g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbu mthing ga phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu/ bar pa gnyis kyis 'khor lo dang rin po che/ tha ma gnyis kyis pad+ma dang ral gri bsnams pa zhal khro la 'dzum pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ rang snang gi yum dang bcas par gyur/ ces brjod/ de nas lag pa gnyis mdun du brkyang ste sor mo rnams gshibs pa kha gyen du bstan te/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍa la/ a tsaṇ+ḍa maṇ+ḍal/ zhes brjod pas/ lag mthil g.yas g.yon du nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor/ de dag gi steng du hūm̐ dang ā las rdo rje dang pad+ma/ g.yas g.yon gyi sor mo la/ oṃ hūm̐ swā ā hā/ saṃ maṃ paṃ laṃ taṃ las rnam par snang mdzad mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/

'od dpag med/ don yod grub pa/ kun du bzang mo/ mā ma kī/ spyan ma/ gos dkar mo/ sgrol ma rnams su gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod cing thal mo sbyar bas/ snyoms par 'jug par bskul te/ badz+ra añdza li hūm̐/ badz+ra ban+dha/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje bsdams pas phan tshun ro gcig tu gyur par bsams la/ badz+ra añdza li dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ yab yum bcu'i sbyor mtshams nas khro chung mtshon cha thogs pa mang po byung ste/ lag mthil gyi hūm̐ dang ā la thim/ phaṭa ces brjod pas sbyor mtshams nas spros pa'i khro bo bcu la bka' bsgo bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ gdug cing sdang sems ldan pa rnams/ /songs shig lha min lha yang rung / /nga la bar chad byed pa'i bdud/ /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul med par byos/ /zhes dang / khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod pas/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs thams cad hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa la sogs pa'i sgra dang bcas pas bskrad/ de nas hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ khro bo rnams rang gi thugs kar thim/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs 'thon/ sna bug g.yas nas byung / g.yas nas bskor bas bgegs bskrad par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ hūm̐ nga yi dkyil 'khor brtan bya'i phyir/ /khro rgyal byin rlabs las byung ba'i/ /mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyis/ /dkyil 'khor rim pa tshul bzhin srungs/ /oṃ badz+ra a yu dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ de'i phyag rgya ni/ rdo rje khu tshur rgyab sbyar/ mthe'u chung gnyis sbrel/ mtheb chen dang srin mdzub rtse sbyar/ mdzub mo dang gung mdzub brkyang ste/ sngags dang po la g.yon du bskor rjes ma la g.yas su bskor bas mtshon cha'i rwa gur du gyur par bsam mo/ /de bzhin du thugs ka'i hūm̐ las rdo rje/ ral gri/ 'khor lo/rgya gram/ dbyug tho dpag tu med pa 'thon nas/ de dag gi rwa gur du gyur par bsams la/

rdo rje bsdams pa'i mthe bong mthe'u chung gung mo rnams mnyam ste bsgreng / mdzub mo gnyis bkug pa'i rtse mo gnyis gung mo'i tshigs gsum par btsugs pa rdo rje'i phyag rgya bcas la/ hūm̐ steng yang rdo rje'i bla re la/ /'og kyang rdo rje'i sa gzhi ste/ /phyogs mtshams rdo rje 'bar bas gtam/ /rdo rje'i mtshams las ma 'da' cig /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ lag pa gnyis kyis mthe bong dang mdzub mo rtse sprad sor mo gzhan gsum brkyangs pa ral gri'i phyag rgya bcas la/ steng yang ral gri'i bla re la/ sogs rigs 'gre/ sngags oṃ khaḍ+ga rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ thal mo rgyab sbyar te sor mo bsnol/ mthe bong lag mthil du bkug pa 'khor lo'i phyag rgya bcas la/ tshig ral gri'i gnas su 'khor lo bcug pa dang / sngags oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod/ sor mo rnams rtse sprad srin lag gnyis nang du bkug pa rgya gram gyi phyag rgya dang / tshig 'khor lo'i gnas su rgya gram bcug pa dang / sngags oṃ bi shwa badz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ sor mo rnams bkug ste rtse sprad pa khong stong du byas pa dbyug tho'i phyag rgya dang / tshig rgya gram gyi gnas su dbyug to bcug pa dang / sngags oṃ badz+ra daṇ+ḍa rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ 'di rnams la g.yon du bskor ba dang g.yas su bskor ba gong bzhin/ sngags tshar gnyis gnyis kyi rjes ma rnams phaṭa 'jog pa'o/ /de nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo shin tu brtan cing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba las mtheb mdzub rtse sprad pa rin po che mig gsum pa'i rnam par byas la/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad nas/ /dmyal ba'i sa gzhi yan chod kyi/ /log par lta ba'i dgra dang bgegs/ /'di ru ma 'dug gzhan du dengs/ /oṃ badz+ra te dz+wa tiṣ+ṭha tsakra rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing g.yon bskor sngags tshar gnyis brjod pa rnams gong bzhin no/

/rwa ba de dag las spros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ thal mo rgyab sbyar gyi sor mo gzhan rnams nang du bsnol/mthe bong rtse sprad pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ phyi rol kun du 'od 'phros pas/ /bdud dpung nges par sreg byed pa/ /sa dang mkha' kun khyab pa yi/ /'bar ba me yis phung por gyur/ /oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma thā bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de sngags tshar gcig gi ring la phyag rgya g.yon dang g.yas su bskor ba'o/ /de nas rang gi mig g.yas par/ ma las nyi ma raṃ gyis mtshan pa las spros pa'i me 'od kyis bgegs thams cad bsregs/ zhes brjod cing bsam la/ hūm̐ g.yas pa'i spyan zur ldog pa yis/ /nyi steng raṃ las 'od 'phros pas/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug brgya byin sogs/ /thams cad ma lus bsreg par bya/ /ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la raṃ/ rang gi mig g.yon par a las zla ba as mtshan pa las me 'od kyis slar gsos/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ g.yon pa'i spyan zur༞ /zla steng a las༞ /tshangs pa dbang phyug༞ /thams cad ma lus gso bar bya/ /a tsan+ḍa maṇ+ḍal la zhes brjod do/ /rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can srung mar bcas pa srung 'khor gyi nang du mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod cing / rdo rje bsdus pa'i phyag rgyas spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo badz+ra kī la ya maṇ+ḍal la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes brjod pas bla ma dang yi dam gyi lha la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de nas bshags pa dngos ni/ sdom gsum sku gsung thugs kyi dam tshig dang / /rtsa ba yan lag nyes byas phra mo dang / /dam tshig che chung tshor dang ma tshor dang / /zla dang zhor gyi dam tshig nyams pa dang / /khas blangs che la nyams blangs chung ba dang / /bka' ltar ma bgyis gzhung ltar ma bsrangs dang / /ting 'dzin lhod gyur 'dzab bzlas nyung ba dang /

/yi dam lha yi bsgom pa g.yel la sogs/ /nyams grib nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus kun/ /phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas byang sems dang / /bla ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma/ /rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dang / dur khrod brgyad gnas dam can mkha' 'gro la/ /sngar byas 'gyod dang phyin chad sdom sems kyis/ /sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang du bshags par bgyi/ /mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /sku gsung thugs kyi bdag nyid can/ /bde gshegs rgyal ba 'khor bcas la/ /lus ngag yid kyis phyag 'tshal lo/ /phyi nang gsang ba bla med pa'i/ /mchod pa kun gyis mchod bgyid cing / /bka' yi bran dang 'bangs kyi phyir/ /bdag gi lus kyang dbul bar bya/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /rnal 'byor mnga' bdag he ru ka /'khor lor bzhugs pa'i bdag nyid can/ /de rnams la'ang skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil 'khor bdag por gyur pa yi/ /byang chub sems kyi dngos po ni/ /khyad par du yang slob dpon la/ /rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /dkyil dang 'khor du bcas pa rnams/ /gtso bo 'khor dang bcas pa yi/ /rnal 'byor 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ni/ /de dag bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /bdag ni dus 'di nas bzung ste/ /ji srid byang chub ma thob bar/ /bdag gi sdom pa ma lus bzung / /bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa gang / /bde gshegs spyan sngar mchis nas su/ /dus gsum sdig pa bgyis pa rnams/ /khyed la ma lus so sor bshags/ /sangs rgyas chos dang byang chub sems/ /rang rgyal dgra bcom nyan thos sogs/ /'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams la/ /de la rjes su yi rang bgyi/ /sems can ma lus srid par ltung / /'gro rnams kun la phan bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis dus 'di nyid du ni/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/

/zhes brjod de/ mdun gyi tshogs zhing de dag thams cad dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod cing rang gi snying gar bstim mo/ /dang po ni/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rje dang byin rlabs bsdus nas bdag dang dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su thim pas byin gyis brlabs par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ hūm̐ 'phags mchog thugs rje'i dus la babs/ /khyad par bstan pa'i dus la babs/ /mthu rtsal dbyung ba'i dus la babs/ /byin gyis rlob pa'i dus la babs/ /dbang chen bskur ba'i dus la babs/ dngos grub stsol ba'i dus la babs/ /mthu chen mthu stobs bcom ldan 'das/ /byin chen byin rlobs dus la babs/ /dbang chen dbang skur dus la babs/ /dngos grub mchog stsol dus la babs/ /bdag gi las 'bras mchis par mdzod/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /ces brjod cing rol mo sgras byin dbab bo/ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod cing ma dag pa bsangs shing bgegs bskrad/ rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po spros pa'i mes bdud rtsi'i snod la reg pas mi gtsang ba bsregs/ yaṃ spros pa'i rlung gis gtor/ khaṃ spros pa'i chus bkrus/ skyon thams cad dag par byas/ bh+rūṃ spros pas bhan+dha 'bar ba'i snod chen por gyur/ oṃ spros pas 'dod pa'i yon tan bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang bar gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam/ sman phud swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me/ keṃ las mi mgo'i sgyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs par/ oṃ hūm̐ hriṃ hrīḥ.āḥlas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga/ ye shes lnga yi ngo bo gyur/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa hūm̐ oṃ swā ā hā las phyag mtshan lngar gyur/ hūm̐ badz+ra dh+rīka oṃ dzi na dz-ika swa rat+na dh+rīka ā a ro l̥ka

ha prañdzā dh+ṝka ces brjod pas he ru ka yab yum bcur gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes brjod pas sbyor ba'i mes 'od du zhu/ oṃ ā hūm̐ du gyur/ de las 'od 'phros pas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bdud rtsi bkug nas thim/ 'og gi bdud rtsi dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛ ta hūm̐ hri thaḥ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad kyi byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma byin brlabs ni/ mes gtor ma'i snod la reg pas sogs dang / 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro sogs 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs/ gong gi bdud rtsi byin rlabs bzhin no/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ te dz+wa ba liṃ ta/ ba la ba te gu h+ya sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥ zhes pa bdun gyis byin gyis brlabs/ rak+ta'i snod a las thod pa yangs par/ raṃ las dgra bgegs bsgral ba'i khrag las byung ba'i bdud rtsir gyur/ ces brjod cing bsams la/ ma hā sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes dang / oṃ ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ hrīḥthaḥzhes pa gsum mam lngas byin gyis brlabs/ yang hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod pas/ phur pa rdo rje gzhon nu'i lus la khro bo bcu brgyan par gyur/ ces brjod cing bsgoms la/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas phur pa byin gyis brlab bo/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa stong pa nyid spros pa dang bral ba chos thams cad kyi rang bzhin de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin dang / stong pa nyid des 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad la khyab cing / de ltar ma rtogs pa rnams la rab tu brtse ba'i snying rje bsgom pa kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang / thabs shes rab gnyis med rang rig gsal la ma 'gags pa de yi ge hūm̐ sngon po gcig tu gyur ba rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin te/

oṃ ma hā shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swā bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ rdo rje khro bo zhe sdang gcod/ /mtshon cha sngon po cher 'bar ba/ /nam mkha'i dkyil du thig le shar/ /srog gi sgo ru shar ba dang / /snying gi dkyil du bsgom par bya/ /hūm̐ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas hūm̐ las raṃ mched/ /snod bcud kyi 'jig rten bsregs/ /yaṃ spros pas rlung gis gtor/ /khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ /skyon thams cad dag par byas/ /zhes brjod cing bsam la/ de nas e yaṃ baṃ raṃ kaṃ e bh+rūṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ e a kā sha maṇ+ḍal la/ yaṃ bā yu maṇ+ḍal la/ baṃ u da ka maṇ+ḍal la/ raṃ te dzo maṇ+ḍal la/ paṃ pri thi bi maṇ+ḍal la/ raṃ rak+ta dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal la/ kaṃ ma hā kaṃ ka la su me ru maṇ+ḍal la/ e ṭi ko naṃ dz+wa la badz+ra pra ka ra ṇa mi brta maṇ+ḍal la/ bh+rūṃ da sha a ra tsakra maṇ+ḍal la zhes brjod pas/ hūm̐ las yi ge de dag spros pas rten gyis dkyil 'khor du gyur/ ces brjod cing bsam la gsal gdab pa ni/ e las mkha' dbyings dag pa nam mkha'i dkyil/ /yaṃ las rlung chen rgya gram sra zhing brtan/ /de steng baṃ las byung ba'i chu dkyil dkar/ /raṃ las me byung bskyed pa de yis phyed/ /laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor brtan par gyur/ /de steng rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rba klong 'khrugs/ /dbus su keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bh+rūṃ las gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ /khog pa stong pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ /rtse mo rno dbal dgra bgegs phye mar rlog /rab tu 'bar ba me yi glog stong 'gyu/ /shin tu 'khor ba'i ngang tshul brtan zhing brjid/ /'khor lo'i dbus su gru gsum mthing nag 'bar/ /mu khyud rdo rje rwa bas rnam par spras/ /phyi rol dur khrod phyogs skyong zhing skyong klu/ /shing me mchod rten chu bo grub pa dang / /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro gnod sbyin srin po dang /

/sha za smyo byed brjed byed ro langs dang / /mdung dang gsal shing rtse yis phug pa'i ro/ /ro dum thod tshal sha khrag rus pas dkris/ /wa dang ce spyang kha 'ug bya rgod dang / /kaṃ ka la sogs pheṃ sgra sgrog pas gang / /zhes brjod cing de'i don bsgoms la/ de nas/ dzaḥdamar po spros pas de las lcags kyu dmar po dpag tu med pa byung ste/ dbang phyug la sogs pa bkug nas/ dbus su pad+ma nyi zla'i steng / rtsibs bcu dang sgo bzhir yang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bstim par bsam zhing / paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la/ ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ a tsan+ḍa maṇ+ḍal la/ ma hā de wa dzaḥ u ma de wi dzaḥ brah+ma dzaḥ in+ḍa dzaḥ ag+ne dzaḥ ya ma ya dzaḥ nai ri ti dzaḥ ba ru ṇa dzaḥ ba ya be dzaḥ ku bhe ra dzaḥ ī shwa ra dzaḥ bhū mi pa ti dzaḥ ma taṃ dzaḥ ma taṃ dzaḥ ma taṃ dzaḥ ma taṃ dzaḥ zhes brjod de/ de dag gis ni rten gyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan zin to/ /bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa dngos ni/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ de dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du babs pa las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas tshur 'dus te 'od du zhu nas rang gtso bor gyur pa ni/ zhes brjod cing bsam la gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku/ /mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ /g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang / /me dpung 'bar ba rtse gsum rnams/ /g.yas g.yon gnyis gnyis phyag gi bsnams/ /mtha' gnyis phur bsgril sku che rags/ /mche gtsigs spyan gsum zlum zhing dmar/ /ral pa kham pa gyen du brdzes/ /glang lpags zhing chen g.yang gzhi gsol/ /stag gi pags pa'i 'og lpags can/ /dkar dmar ljang nag sbrul gyis brgyan/ /dbu rgyan se ral sked chings dang / /phyag dang zhabs rnams rnam par spras/

/thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis spras/ /zhabs bzhi g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang nas/ /dbang phyug kha phub mgo bo dang / /u ma'i nu ma rab tu brdzis/ /ye shes me dpung dbus na gzhug /zhes brjod/ de nas rang gi phung po khams dang skye mched skra nyis khri chig stong / ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi la sogs pa thams cad kyang rdo rje gzhon nu rang dang 'dra ba go mtshams med pas gtams par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsams la/ de nas/ rang gi snying kha'i nang du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang sor bzhi pa sgo gcig pa mdun du bstan pa'i sgo srung rta mgrin yab yum gyis byas pa'i nang du ma las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra ba tshon gang pa'i thugs kar nyi ma la hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa nas 'bru tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ yungs 'bru tsam gyi mtha' mar kī la ya skra shad kyis bris pa ltar bus bskor bar bsams la/ snying rjes bsgral ba'i dam tshig ni/ /bcad cing mnan pa nyid min te/ /phung po rdo rje'i bdag nyid de/ /rnam par shes pa rdo rjer bsgom/ /bh+rūṃ bi mā na ma sūr+ya hūm̐ dz+nyā na satwa kṛṣ+ṇa shu ka pañtsa badz+ra hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas 'chi med srog gi lung ngam/ thugs ye shes su bsgom pa zhes bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ dip+ta tsakra hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas yum bskyed par bya ste/ phyag mtshan ni sngags dang bstun na 'khor lo gsal bas gsal gdab pa ni/ bh+yoḥyum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas 'khor lo/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /gzig gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ /rus pa'i rgyan lngas sku la spras/ /thod skam lnga yis dbu la brgyan/ /skam po lnga bcu'i do shal byas/

/sbrul dang rin chen rgyan gyis brgyan/ /rak+ta zhag dang thal chen gyi/ /thig le zo ris tshom bur byas/ /zhabs gnyis g.yas g.yon brkyang bskum gyis/ /yab kyi g.yon nas 'khyud pas bzhugs/ /zhes brjod/ bdag gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros snod bcud la phog pas gzhal yas khang dang lhar gyur par bsams/ rdo rje gzhon nu'i rig 'dzin rnams/ /'khor ba rdo rje bsgrub par mdzod/ /oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ yang hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas ye shes sems dpa' mdun du spyan drangs par bsam zhing / 'khor ba rdo rje phur bu'i lha/ /ye shes khro bo 'grub par mdzod/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' de nyid sgo ma bzhi'i sngags kyis rang la dgug gzhug cing mnyes par byas par bsams zhing / oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā ra ṇi hūm̐ hoḥ zhes brjod/ gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bsam pa las 'od 'phros/ sku gsung thugs kyi lha grangs med pa spyan drangs shing thim pa las/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom la/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /rdo rje de nyid rang bzhin las/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo nyid/ /'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ /sku yi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes gsung / /sogs nas༞ gsung gi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta wāka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes thugs/ sogs nas/ thugs kyi gter du bdag bskyed cig /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ yang thugs ka nas 'od 'phros khro bo rigs lnga dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te dbang bskur bar gsol ba bdab par bsam zhing /

thabs kyi spyod pas sems can don/ /byams dang snying rjes gang 'dul ba/ /sangs rgyas phrin las rdzogs par mdzod/ /dbang dang byin rlabs 'dir stsol cig /ces brjod/ de nas ye shes kyi chus dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang / dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las spyi bor he ru ka yab yum gyis dbu brgyan par bsam zhing / oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhi shwa ri hūm̐/ oṃ bud+dha shrī he ru ka bud+dha kro dhī shwa ri oṃ/ oṃ rat+na shrī he ru ka rat+na kro dhī shwa ri traṃ/ oṃ pad+ma shrī he ru ka pad+ma kro dhī shwa ri hrīḥ oṃ karma shrī he ru ka karma kro dhī shwa ri āḥ zhes brjod/ des ni bdag nyid rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan zin to/ /phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa ni/ hūm̐ las oṃ badz+ra kro dhā hūm̐ ka ra/ zhes brjod pas khro bo hūm̐ ka ra/ hūm̐ brjod pas yum dang / gardza gardza zhes brjod pas phyag brnyan dang / phra men dang / hūm̐ phaṭa ces pas de rnams bskul te thugs ka nas thon nas gdan gyi steng du 'khod par bsam/ de bzhin du/ 'og ma rnams la yang sbyar ro/ /de nas gsal gdab pa ni/ hūm̐ mdzad dkar dmar dbus sngo zhal/ /rtsa phyag rdo rje thod khrag dang / /bar pa rdo rje dril bu bsnams/ /tha mas phur bsgril yum la 'khyud/ /oṃ karma kro dhī di pa ya ti hūm̐/ lha mo rdo rje sgra 'byin sngo/ /zhal gcig phyag g.yas dril bu bsnams/ /g.yon pas thod khrag yab la stobs/ /brkyang bskum gar gyis gnyis med sbyor/ /oṃ badz+ra pu ka ra mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra i ṣu sa mu khi/ g.yas phyogs sprul pa'i phyag brnyan ni/ /mdog dkar phag gi mgo bo can/ /phyags g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba thogs/ /g.yon pas phur 'dril nyi stong bzhugs/ /phra men smig bu'i mgo can g.yon/ /dmar mo dril bu phur pa bsnams/ /nyi ma'i gdan la gar gyis rol/ /steng phyogs 'khor lo'i rtsibs dbus bzhugs/

/oṃ badz+ra kro dhā bi dza ya hūm̐/ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ rnam rgyal dkar dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pa lcags kyu rnga yab bsnams/ /tha mas phur 'drel༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī lā s+yā ki hūm̐/ lha mo rdo rje sgeg mo nag /zhal gcig༞ /g.yon pas༞ brkyang bskum gar gyis༞ /oṃ badz+ra byā gh+ri la mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gh+ri ḍh+ra mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs sprul pa'i phyag brnyan ni/ /mdog dkar stag gi༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /g.yon pas phur༞ /phra men bya rgod༞ /dmar mo rnga yab༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /shar phyogs 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhā nī la dan+ḍa hūm̐/ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ dbyug sngon dkar dmar dbus sngo zhal/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas dbyug tho me dbal bsnams/ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī tā tā hūm̐/ rdo rje ser mo sngo༞ /tshig rkang rjes ma gsum 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra tsa ma ra mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra kro ṇa mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog dkar g.yag gi༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje dbyug tho dang / /g.yon pa༞ /phra men bya rog༞ /dmar mo me dbal༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /me mtshams 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhā ya man+ta ka hūm̐/ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ gshin rje dkar dmar dbus sngo zhal/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas dbyug pa dgra satwa bsnams/ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī sha ma shwa na pa ti hūm̐/ dud khrod bdag mo sku mdog sngo/ /gzhan gsum 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra ha ri na mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra u lu ka mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog dkar sha ba'i༞ /phyags g.yas rdo rje dbyug pa༞ /g.yon pa༞ /phra men 'ug pa'i༞ /dmar mo dgra satwa༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /lho phyogs 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ār+ya a tsa la hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ mi g.yo dkar dmar dbus mthing zhal/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas ral gri zhags pa bsnams/ /tha ma༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī mu kha la hūm̐/ lha mo rdo rje gtun khung nag /gzhan gsum 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra ār+ya mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pre ta mu khi hūm̐/

g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog dkar gzig gi༞ /phyag g.yas ral gri 'bar ba༞ /g.yon pas༞ /phra men khwa ta'i༞ /dmar mo zhags pa༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /lho nub 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐/ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ rta mgrin sngo dkar rtsa zhal dmar/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas pad+ma sbrul zhags༞ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī dzā ya ti hūm̐/ lha mo rdo rje gtum mo dmar/ /gzhan gsum 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra bi ḍā la mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pak+ṣi mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog sngo byi la'i༞ /phyag g.yas pad+ma dmar po༞ /g.yon pa༞ /phra men pu shud༞ /dkar mo sbrul zhags༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /nub phyogs 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐/ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gzhan gyis༞ /nag dmar dkar༞ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas rdo rje 'khor lo bsnams/ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhi sa byā ti hūm̐/ rdo rje lha mo mda' snyems dkar/ /gzhan gsum 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra sri kha la mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañtsa ra mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog nag ce spyang༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba༞ /g.yon pas༞ /phra men khra yi༞ /dmar mo 'khor lo༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /nub byang 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐/ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'khyil pa dkar dmar dbus zhal ljang / /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas rgya gram be con bsnams/ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī sa byā mi ta hūm̐/ rdo rje lha mo sgra mdzad ljang / /gzhan gsum 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra singha mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ti ti la mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog dkar seng ge'i mgo༞ /phyag g.yas rgya༞ /g.yon pas༞ /phra men pha wang༞ /dmar mo be con༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /byang phyogs 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dzā ya hūm̐/ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ 'jig rten gsum rgyal sngo ljang ser/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas rdo rje tri shu la/ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhī mā ra ya hūm̐/ lha mo rdo rje gsol byed ser/

/gzhan gsum 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nā ku la mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog sngo dred kyi༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje 'bar ba༞ /g.yon pas༞ /phra men sbre mong༞ /ljang gu rtse gsum༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /byang shar 'khor lo'i༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐/ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ stobs chen dkar dmar dung mdog zhal/ /rtsa phyag༞ /bar pas tho ba gtun shing༞ /tha mas༞ /oṃ badz+ra kro dhi muṇ+ḍe na maṃ hūm̐/ rigs byed ma ni du ba'i mdog /gzhan gsum 'dra/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa sa mu kha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ka shi ka mu khi hūm̐/ g.yas phyogs༞ /mdog dkar dom gyi༞ /phyags g.yas rdo rje tho ba༞ /g.yon pas༞ /phra men byi ba'i༞ /dmar mo gtun shing༞ /nyi ma'i gdan la༞ /'og phyogs༞ /oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra wi hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra mā ra ni hūm̐ ho/ bh+yoḥshar phyogs sgo srung gnod sbyin mo/ /mdog dkar pu shud mgo bo can/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu bsnams/ /g.yon pas phur 'dril ro steng bzhugs/ /lho phyogs sgo srung 'jigs byed ma/ /mdog ser bya rog༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje zhags pa༞ /g.yon pa༞ /nub phyogs sgo srung bdud rtsi ma/ /mdog dmar srin bya'i༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje lcags sgrog༞ /g.yon pa༞ /byang phyogs sgo srung gsod byed ma/ /mdog ljang khra yi༞ /phyag g.yas rdo rje dril bu༞ /g.yon pas༞ /khro chen 'khor bcas yab yum rnams/ /rgyan sogs yab yum tshul bzhin te/ /kun kyang rdo rje'i gshog pa can/ /me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs/ /dkyil 'khor phyi rim khor yug na/ /dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis sogs/ /dam tshig la dgongs 'khod par gyur/ /ces brjod/ de dag gi zhar la dam can dang / /bstan ma chos skyong rnams kyang srung 'khor gyi nang rol du sprin phung 'thib pa bzhin du bzhugs par bsgom mo/ /de dag gi ni phyogs bcu khro bo'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan to/

/phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bstan pa ni/ e s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces brjod pas phur gdan gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba bskyed/ sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ zhes brjod pas der dgra bgegs thams cad bkug phur pa gu gul gyis bdug cing a mṛ ta brjod cing bgegs bsangs/ kī la ya'i rjes la sarba bigh+nan rak+ṣa rak+ṣa/ zhes brjod cing / yungs dkar thum bu gdags pa'i gtor mas mthu dang ldan par bsams la/ hūm̐ skye med rnam dag chos kyis dbyings nyid las/ /skye ba'i cho 'phrul 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba yab yum ma lus kun/ /sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig chos kyi dbyings nas bzhengs/ /zhes brjod pas/ chos sku las longs sku he ru kar bzhengs par bskul ba/ yab yum gyi mkha' nas longs sku rigs lnga yab yum sprul par bsam ste/ phyag mtshan g.yas bar pa rigs lnga'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa/ gzhan gtso bo dang 'dra bar mngon no/ /de nas longs sku las sprul sku sras mchog sprul par gsol ba gdab pa'i phyir/ hūm̐ dbus kyi mthing nag gru gsum dkyil 'khor nas/ /rdo rje 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /zhe sdang bdud 'dul khro rgyal dbyings nas bzhengs/ /srid pa rdo rje phur bu bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /mthing nag gru gsum 'bar ba'i gnas 'dir gshegs/ /badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥ de bzhin du 'don pa bsgyur te/ shar phyogs smug nag༞ /bud+dha 'dus pa'i༞ /gti mug bdud 'dul༞ /srid pa rdo rje༞ /smug nag gru gsum༞ /bud+dha kī li kī la ya dzaḥ lho phyogs ser nag༞ /rin chen 'dus pa'i༞ /nga rgyal bdud 'dul༞ /srid pa rdo rje༞ /ser nag gru gsum༞ /rat+na kī li kī la ya dzaḥ nub phyogs dmar nag༞ /pad+ma 'dus pa'i༞ /'dod chags bdud 'dul༞ /srid pa rdo rje༞ /dmar nag gru gsum༞ /pad+ma kī li kī la ya dzaḥ

byang phyogs ljang nag༞ /karma 'dus pa'i༞ /phrag dog bdud 'dul༞ /srid pa rdo rje༞ /ljang nag gru gsum༞ /karma kī li kī la ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dap+ti tsakra kī li kī la ya༞ sogs gong gi 'gre/ oṃ dip+ta rat+na༞ oṃ dip+ta pad+ma༞ oṃ dip+ta karma༞ zhes brjod pas longs sku rigs lnga thams cad sprul sku sras mchog rigs lnga sku stod khro bo zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ smad phur bu'i dbal gyi rnam pa can du gyur par bsam zhing / de rnams kyi sgo gsum du spyi bor oṃ/ sked par hrī/ rtse mor phaṭa ces brjod cing bsams la/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa spyan drangs/ sa mā ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas ye shes pa bstims/ de nas oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka badz+ra kro dhīḥshwa ri hūm̐/ zhes pa nas/ karma kro dhīḥshwa ri āḥ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod cing dbang bskur/ de nas ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ a tsan+d+ra maṇ+ḍal la hūm̐ āḥ oṃ/ hūm̐/ swā/ a/ hā/ saṃ/ maṃ/ laṃ/ paṃ/ taṃ/ sa mā ya satwaṃ/ badz+ra añtsa li hūm̐/ badz+ra bhan+dha badz+ra añtsa li dzaḥ zhes brjod cing / 'di'i don rnams gong bzhin bsam la/ phur bu chu srin rnam grol gyi phyag rgyas bzung la/ dip+ta tsakra phur pa'i lha/ /mthing nag gcer bu ral pa can/ /sku stod khro bo chen po la/ /zhal gsum phyag kyang drug pa ste/ /dbu la rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas rdzogs/ /lte ba man chad sku yi cha/ /ut+pal sngon po'i 'dab 'dra ba/ /'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ /lcags kyi phur pa zur gsum pa/ /drag por gyur pa'i phur pa ste/ /btab na lha yang brlag 'gyur na/ /gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa/ de bzhin du bud+dha/ rat+na/ pad+ma/ karma sogs sngar gyi sras mchog rigs lnga'i sngags kyi mjug tu/

badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa sogs btags pa brjod cing / spyi gtsug la sogs pa gnas lnga dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du 'og ma gnyis la yang 'go 'dra ba la/ wāk+ka a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ gsum gyi sngags brjod cing sgo gsum du reg la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dbang / mthu rtsal dang byin rlabs kyi dbang bskur bar bsam zhing phur gdan la bzhag go /des ni phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang dngos bstan te/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang 'dra ba'i ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs bar bsam zhing / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'khor ba phur bu sgrub don du/ /dbang dang byin brlabs zhu ba'i phyir/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs su gsol/ /ye shes khro bo gshegs nas kyang / /rtags dang mtshan ma bstan pa dang / /phur pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ e h+ya hi bhā ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka tri sh+ya hoḥs ma ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ pra be sha ya phaṭa/ a be sha ya āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas dam tshig pas phyag 'tshal ba ni/ khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la ya/ /thugs rje zhi ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /skye med dbyings las sprul pa'i sku byung ba/ /'jigs byed rngams stabs khro mo'i tshul du ston/ /khro rgyal sku la gnyis med lhun sbyor ba/ /'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /ma g.yos che mchog sku gsung thugs kyi bdag /sdug bsngal log par 'khyams pa'i sems can rnams/ /thugs rje dbyer med dbyings su sdud mdzad pa/ /sprul pa'i khro bo rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /khro bo dbang phyug sku la nyer gnas pa/ /thabs dang shes rab 'dren pa'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /mkha' 'gro mi bzad 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba/ /gdug pa 'dul mdzad rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nam mkha'i lus can gar yang thogs med cing /

/'dod dgur bsgyur pa'i gzugs can 'phrul mo che/ /ma sring byams pa'i tshul gyis grogs mdzad ma/ /phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /a ti pu hoḥ pra ti dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya/ sa pa ri wā ra pā dāṃ bhan+dhaṃ ka ro mi/ yang dag don du dag mod kyang / /'gro ba kun gyi don slad du/ /phyag dang zhabs ni bsil nas kyang / /rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka sa pa ri wā ri hasta tsa pā d+yaṃ pra tits+tsha swāhā/ badz+ra ā pa na tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal zhing / zhabs bsil gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ nas/ bde bar gshegs so khro rgyal gtso/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes kyi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtsho mtha' yas kun/ /kun bzang mchod sprin mchog tu rol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/zhes mchod pa thams cad kyis mchod la/ bde bar gshegs pa khyod ci 'dra/ /de 'dra kho nar bdag gyur cig /spyod pa rmad byung bsam yas pa/ /'gro la phan phyir bdag gis spyad/ /byang chub sems mchog dam pa dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi phyag rgya 'di/ /srog gi phyir yang mi gtong na/ /rdo rje rgyal pos byin brlabs mdzod/ /bskal pa tha ma'i 'jig rten 'dir/ /sangs rgyas mdzad dka' bdag gis bgyid/ /byang chub spyad dka' bdag gi spyad/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /bdag cag bsam pa 'grub gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba ta thā ga ta sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ṇi hūm̐ dzaḥ sogs gong bzhin sgo ma bzhi'i sngags brjod la dgug zhugs bcings mnyes par bsam/ de nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ /zhes pa nas/ karma kro dhi shwa ri āḥ zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin brjod la dbang bskur ro/ /de dag gis ni phur pa rdzas kyi dkyil 'khor bskyed pa bstan to// ༈ /rang gi thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas/

rdo rje gzhon nu lha lnga bcu rtsa gcig gi dkyil 'khor la dam can srung mas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsam zhing / bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum dang / /sprul pa yang sprul bka' bstod srung ma'i tshogs/ /glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir gshegs nas/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sa pa ri wā ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod/ yang dag don du sogs sngags bcas dang / bde bar gshegs so sogs sngags bcas brjod cing zhabs bsil gdan 'bul zhing bzhugs su gsol/ mchod pa la/ phyi mchod/ sman mchod/ gsang mchod/ bsgral mchod/ gtor ma/ bstod pa/ 'dzab mchod dang bdun gyi dang po ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas spros pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bdag dang mdun gyi lha la mchod par bsam zhing / sgeg phreng glu gar bdug pa me tog ma/ /mar me dri ma nyer spyod rol mo yis/ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /bla ma dkyil 'khor dam can srung ma la/ /rnam dag blo yi mos blos bdag 'bul na/ /bzhes shig kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /badz+ra lā s+ya hūm̐/ badz+ra mā l+ya trāṃ/ badz+ra girti hrīḥ badz+ra nirti āḥ badz+ra dhu pe hūm̐/ badz+ra puṣ+pe trāṃ/ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gnyis pa bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa ni/ mtheb srin sbyar bas bdud rtsi gtor la/ thugs ka nas spros pa'i ro rdo rje mas bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa thogs la mchod par bsam zhing / rang byung gdod nas dag pa yi/ /rtsa brgyad stong la sbyar ba'i sman/ /rigs lnga dam tshig lnga yi dngos/ /ye shes lnga rdzogs grub pa'i rdzas/ /rgyud lnga sems can kun sgrol phyir/ /dug lnga sel ba'i bdud rtsi 'di/

/ji snyed sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs chen po/ /thugs dam dbyings nyid bskul ba'i phyir/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras bcas la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngang nyid du/ /bdag cag dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes te kun tu dges mdzod la/ /'phrul gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta shrī kā pā la bhan+dha ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta kha kha khā hi khā hī/ rgyal ba kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad dang / /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rje cher dgongs༞ /ma hā pañtsa༞ 'jigs byed chen po khro bo yab yum bcu/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs yab yum nyi shu dang / /sgo ma bzhi dang sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rjes༞ /ma hā pañtsa༞ phyi nang mkha' 'gro 'khor bcas thams cad dang / /ging chen bco brgyad ging phran 'bum sde dang / /dpag bsam shing lha re ma ti rnams la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs༞ /ma hā pañtsa༞ shwa na mu kha bdag nyid chen po dang / /bse yi lha mo phyogs bcu'i rnal 'byor tshogs/ /dam srung mched lcam bstan ma bcu gnyis la/ /rnam dag༞ /thugs rje༞ /ma hā pañtsa༞ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du khā hi/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi༞ /chos sku kun tu bzang po'i༞ /longs sku rdo rje sems dpa'i༞ /sprul sku pad+ma 'byung gnas༞ /dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ /khyad par chos skyong srung ma'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hī/ zhes brjod/ rang gi lce la nang mchod bzhag nas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob pa'i/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag thams cad la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /dpral ba lce rtse snying ga rnams su reg ste/ kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāk+ka sid+dhi āḥ tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ 'dir rgyud las dngos su mi 'byung yang /

phyag len la mdzad pas/ bde ba byang chub sems kyi mchod pa ni/ lha thams cad yab yum snyoms par zhugs pas byang sems 'phel te sku'i cha thams cad la thim pas/ zag pa med pa'i bde bas mnyes par bsam zhing / 'khril ba'i mchod chen mnyam sbyor ba/ /thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa'i/ /pad+mo la ni rdo rje zhugs/ /bdag nyid mchod pas mnyes par byos/ /sa ma ya hoḥ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ rā ga a nu rā ga ya mi bo dhi tsit+ta/ mnyam pa'i sgrub rdzas chen po ste/ /bdag dang mnyam pa'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bza' dang bca' ba btung dang bgo /longs spyod mnga' ldan thams cad ni/ /dkyil 'khor la yang dkyil 'khor thim/ /a la la te dkyil 'khor thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥshrī he ru ka ma hā badz+ra/ a be sha ya a be sha ya/ prā be sha ya/ prā be sha ya/ ma hā su kha pra tīts+tsha ho/ pra ti gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ zhes brjod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa'o/ /bzhi pa bsgral mchod ni/ rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo khro mo phra thabs sgo ma sras mchog dam can gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa spros nas dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams thams cad bsgral bar bsam zhing / dzaḥdam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /sprul pa chen po'i dus la babs/ /pho nya chen po'i dus la babs/ /bdag nyid chen mo'i dus la babs/ /sa bdag rgyal mo'i dus la babs/ /khyi yi gdong can dus la babs/ /bsgral bar bya ba'i dus la babs/ /byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bzhin du/ /rig 'dzin bdag cag rnams la ni/ /gnod cing gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /bdud dang bar du gcod pa rnams/ /khro bo chen po'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yud tsam gyis ni 'dir bkug nas/ /mngon spyod tshul gyis bsgral ba dang / /lus ngag phye mar mdzad nas kyang / /sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /oṃ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ satwaṃ bhā ni mo hāṃ/ ghā ta ya bhā ga wān hrīḥṣ+ṭi bi kṛ badz+ra hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐/ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ

sarba bigh+nan badz+ra kī li kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ kha taṃ kha taṃ kha taṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha kha kha khā hi khā hī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bsgral la/ de'i sha khrag klad pa rus pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing / he ru kā'i gnas bcu dang / /dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas/ /dpal chen 'khor bcas spyan drangs te/ /dur khrod mchog gi gnas 'di ru/ /zhing chen gsar rnying ti rar bcas/ /dmar gyi a rgya mtshor bskyil/ /mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā sa ma ya rak+ṣa sa mu dra kha kha khā hi khā hi/ hṝ da ya pi pa tha hūm̐ phaṭa/ nga ni za byed chen mo ste/ /khams gsum ma lus bsgral ba dang / /gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul ba'i phyir/ /sha rus la sogs bza' bar bya/ /nga ni khrag 'thung chen po ste/ /dmar gyi a rgya mtshor bskyil/ /'khor ba'i drwa ba gcod pa'i phyir/ /'khor gyi phra men tshogs rnams kyis/ /ma lus gshegs nas bsnams su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka ma hā ru dhi ra khā hi/ ma ha maṃ sa khā hi/ ma hā ma ta ka khā hi/ ma hā as+d+yi khā hī/ de thams cad la gtor ma'i thad du rak+ta bsgrengs te/ de nas bsgral ba'i mchod pa zhes bya ste/ 'di tshogs kyi skabs su byed kyang rgyud kyi rim pa bzhin/ rje btsun chen pos mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brang ba'o/ /lnga pa gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyi ljags las byung ba'i 'od zer gyi sbu gus gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing / bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /thugs dam bzhin du ci bder bzhes su gsol/ /dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ shrī he ru ka i daṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhu paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ ba liṃ ta/ pra tīts+tsha hoḥ gṛh+ṇa khā hi/ badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dha/

kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes brjod pas dbul lo/ /de nas lha thams cad dges nas ha ha zhes gsung zhing / hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pas bdag la byin gyis brlabs nas phaṭa phaṭa ces pas dgra bgegs bsgral te chos nyid du gnas par bsam zhing / de nyid ni gtor ma'i mchod pa ste/ thog mar 'byung yang rje btsun chen po'i gsung btsan par byas pa'o/ /drug pa bstod pa ni/ sgeg cing dpa' ba mi sdug tshul ston cing / /rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs su rung ba dang / /snying rje rngams dang zhi ba la sogs pa'i/ /sku yi dngos po gar dgu bsgyur ba ni/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /bdud bzhi gdan du bting bas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /zhal g.yas dkar la bzhad pas rgod rgod 'dra/ /zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ /zhal dbus mthing la rngams pas khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas brtse brtse 'dra/ /gdug pa zhal du gsol bas rngams rngams 'dra/ /chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtogs pa 'joms/ /rdo rje rtse lngas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /me dpung 'bar bas 'khor ba'i nyon mongs sreg /kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /ri rab phur bus dgra bgegs gzir bar byed/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /tshur byon mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la/ /thugs rje che dgongs dbang dang dngos grub stsol/ /de dang gnyis med sbyor ba'i yum mchog ni/ /e ka dza ṭi gu h+ya gsang ba'i yum/ /tshur byon sogs rkang pa gnyis gong bzhin 'gre/ hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang smrig bu'i mgo /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khā ta'i mgo /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo

/gzhan gyis mi thub mda' snyems spyang khra'i mgo /'khyil pa sgra mdzad seng ge pha wam mgo /khams gsum gsod ma dred dang sre mong mgo /stobs chen rig byed dom dang byi la'i mgo /gnod sbyin 'jigs ma bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /de 'dra'i lha tshogs 'jigs pa'i skur ston pas/ /tshur byon༞ sogs rkang pa gnyis 'gre/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i bka' srung dam can tshogs dag pas sogs/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / /bdag nyid chen po shwa na mu kha dang / /sa bdag chen po sa yi lha mo bzhi/ /phyi phyin bse phyin ya phyin phag phyin ma/ /tshur byon༞ sogs rkang pa gnyis 'gre/ 'dod chags khros pa'i me ni dmar nag 'bar/ /zhe sdang khros pa'i me ni mthing nag 'bar/ /gti mug khros pa'i me ni smug nag 'bar/ /nga rgyal khros pa'i me ni ser nag 'bar/ /phrag dog khros pa'i me ni ljang nag 'bar/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/ /khro rgyal 'dus pa'i sras mchog kī la la/ /lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu sku bzhengs shig /bdud dang log 'dren tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /drag po phur pa'i tshul du sku bzhengs shig /dbu la rgya mdud khro rgyal rigs lnga gtso/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi steng 'og khro rgyal bcu/ /steng gi rgya mdud khro chen hūm̐ kā ra/ /phyogs bzhi mtshams bzhi phyogs mtshams khro rgyal brgyad/ /'og gi rgya mdud khro chen stobs po che/ /zur bzhi rgya mdud sgo ma rnam pa bzhi/ /rtse mo gru gsum gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'dul/ /khong stong byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod cing bstod do/ /bdun pa 'dzab kyi mchod pa ni/ hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya/ zhes brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' las/ de dang 'dra ba yum med gcig mdun du byon nas/ rang la zhal phyogs par bzhugs par bsams la/ dz+nyā na satwa/ e tri ko na bi ma na/ paṃ pad+ma maṇ+ḍal la/

ma sūr+ya maṇ+ḍal la/ a tsan+ḍa maṇ+ḍal la/ hūm̐ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rang gi snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gi dbus su pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan la/ ye shes sems dpa' rang 'dra yum med pa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje sngon po nas 'bras tsam gyi lte bar hūm̐ sngon po yungs 'bru tsam gyi mthar sngags phreng kha dog sngon po skra shad kyis bris pa lta bu g.yas skor du bsam nas/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /dbang phyug u ma bsnol ba'i gdan stengs su/ /bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu ni/ /sku mdog mthing nag 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med/ /'khor gyi phra men pho nya'i tshogs la sogs/ /yun ring dus nas bsnyen cing bsgrubs pa'i lha/ /drag po rang byung dbang dang dngos grub rtsol/ /ces brjod pas/ rang gi snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las sngags phreng kha dog sngon po 'od zer dmar po 'phro ba lcags sgrogs sbrel ba lta bu rdo rje'i rwa dbus byung / ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas dang rang gi sna bug g.yas nas phyir 'thon/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim/ yang de nas sngags phreng mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yas nas 'thon/ rang gi sna bug g.yon dang ye shes sems dpa'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs/ rdo rje'i dbus nas song / rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ la thim par bsam zhing / sngags phreng phyir 'gro dus de las rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib bgegs dang bar gcod thams cad zhi bar byas/ sems can thams cad yi dam gyi lhar gyur/ sngags phreng nang du 'ong dus sangs rgyas byang sems/ bla ma yi dam thams cad kyi byin brlabs rdo rje gzhon nu'i skur byas nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs te/

sngags phreng rgyun mi chad par 'khor bar bsam zhing sems gtad la/ dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan par bsam pa ni man ngag dam pa yin no/ /bsrung bzlog bsad gsum gyi dmigs pa ni/ rang gi snying khar ye shes sems dpa'i thugs khar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar rang gi sems hūm̐ yig sngon po 'bar ba'i klad kor gyi nang du bla ma zhal bzhugs pa rnams kyi mtshan yig dang po thig les brgyan pa/ mdun du pha ma/ g.yas su bu dang chung ma/ g.yon du spun zla/ rgyab tu 'khor g.yog 'og tu nor rdzas rnams yod par bsam la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros bsrung bya rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum bkug nas sngar gyi gnas su 'khod/ 'od zer gyis rang dang bsrung bya'i nad ༈ phyir gtor nas lus thams cad la rdo rje'i go cha zhes pa'ang 'dug gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dag par byas/ rdo rje'i go cha gon par bsam pa ni lus bsrung ba/ rang gi lce hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa hūm̐ gis mtshan pa'i rwa rnams la kī la ya'i sngags phreng bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad dag par bsam pa ni ngag bsrung ba snying kha'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' de/ rang dang rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs gnyis su med par bsam pa ni yid bsrung ba'o/ /rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo bcu/ phra thabs/ sgo ma dam can rnams bskul ste/ de dag las sprul pa yang sprul dang / nying sprul grangs med par spros nas dgra bgegs kyi lus ngag yid gsum rnams phye mar byas shing / khro bo phra thabs sgo ma rnams kyang zhal phyir gzigs te/ gnod pa phyir bzlog pa'i las mdzad/ 'khor lo yang g.yon du 'khor bar bsam pa bzlog pa'i dmigs pa'o/ /'khor lo'i rtsibs bar rnams su yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du byad ma lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa/ spyi bo tshugs su gnas pa re re bsam/

rang gi snying ga nas pho nya lcags kyu dang zhags pa thogs pa mang po spros nas/ dgra bgegs gang na gnas pa'i yul nas gzugs dang rnam shes rang dbang med par bkug ste/ rtsibs bar gyi byad ma rnams la bstim/ rang dang bsrung bya'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byad ma'i lus kyi bu ga dgu nas nag thibs te zhugs pas 'khor lo'i rtsibs g.yon du myur du 'khor bas/ 'og gi rlung mes bskyod cing / rtsibs rnams ral gri'i so lta bus dgra bgegs kyi lus dum bu dum bur gtubs/ lhag ma pho nya rnams kyis zos mid brlag par byas par bsam pa ni bsad pa'o/ /rang gis sngags bzlas pa'i dus su khro bo/ phra thabs/ sgo ma/ dam can rnams dang / mdun du spyan drangs pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad de/ sngags kyi sgra 'brug ltar grags par bsam la/ de nas bzlas bya'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dap+ti tsakra ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gardza gardza hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha bi dza ya hūm̐ ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha nī la daṇ+ḍa hūm̐ da ha da ha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ pa tsa pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ar+ya a tsa la hūm̐ bhan+dha bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hūm̐ hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a pa ra dzi ta hūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya hūm̐ bhin+dha bhin+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la hūm̐ s+pho ṭa s+pho ṭa hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣi ni hūm̐ dza/ oṃ badz+ra bhai ra we hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta hūm̐ baṃ/ oṃ ma ra ni hūm̐ hoḥ de las gtso bo yab yum khro bo bcu/ sgo ma bzhi rnams gtso bo la brgya rtsa sogs phyag len bzhin bzlas shing /

dbang phyug ma rnams la bh+yoḥbadun bdun bzlas rjes gzhi snying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags 'di yang bzla bar bya'o/ /ma rak+mo yak+mo kā la ru pa snying rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ srog rtsa la yaṃ yaṃ/ snying la khril khril/ srog la chum chum/ tsit+ta srog la tum tum/ thum ril ril/ snying khrag srog la shan shan/ snying tshag tshag 'ur 'ur/ shig shig gul gul/ nyag nyag sod sod/ dha ti ma mā shrī gh+raṃ karma ka ra/ mā ra se nā pra marda ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces tshar gcig bzlas tshar ba dang / 'jigs pa nyams par byed/༈ oṃ bhā ya nā sa ni tra sa ni sarba ༈ skrag par byed/ ma ra pra t+yaṃ gi ra ༈ bdud thams cad phyir zlog par byed/ bi nā sa ni/ ye ke tsita/ duṣ+ṭan satwa ma ma bi tū pa kaṃ kurban ti tā ni sarba ma ra ṇi pra t+yaṃ ka ri ༈ rnam par nyams par byed/ gang ci yang rung ba gdug pa'i sems can/ bdag la ngan par byed pa de dag la bdud thams cad phyir bzlog par gyis shig ṇi pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar thal mo sbyar nas/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun kyi༞ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum/ phra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis rnams kyi bden pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi sbyor ba ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/

/ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ /mthu brlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrubs pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig ces brjod cing lag mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang / sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par bsam te/ gnod byed rnams de'i bar du btsir par bsams la thal mo brdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra'i khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa du ma spros te gnod byed kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsreg rlung gis gtor bar bsam la/ spro na/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa zhes pa'i bar gzhan dang 'dra'o/ /phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la kha rlangs phog par byas la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces brjod cing phreng bas mgo thog tu byin brlab bya/ de nas mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pas rang nyid bkrag mdangs gzi brjid nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par gyur/ lha tshogs 'khor bcas ma lus kun/ /sngon gyi thugs dam rjes dgongs la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsol/ /ces brjod de/ dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma la dmigs nas/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor tshul dang / oṃ badz+ra kro dha a mṛ ta sogs dang / rang gi thugs ka nas raṃ dmar po nas/ bdud rtsi bkug nas thim gyi bar gong bdud rtsi'i byin brlab bzhin la 'og gi gtor ma dang 'dres pas gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/

zhes dang / dkar bdud phur srung gi gtor ma lag pa g.yon g.yas gnyis ka bya khyung gi phyag rgya rnams bstan nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ho lan gsum brjod/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan gyi steng du bh+yoḥdakar po yongs su gyur pa las dkar mo nyi zla stong gi phreng ba can sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pas ri rab sgong rdor 'phen zhing / g.yon pas gling bzhi byo ldog tu mdzad pa/ nyi zla brgya yis dbu la brgyan cing / nyi zla dgu brgyas do shal byas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan dang dar dkar po'i na bza' can ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs gnyis mnyam pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ de'i g.yon du rta nag po'i steng du/ hūm̐ las bdud kyi rgyal po thod pa'i phreng ba can sku mdog nag po zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing ljags 'dril ba/ phyag g.yas pas ba dan nag po nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing / g.yon pa rus 'phreng 'phyar thabs su 'dzin pa dar nag gi na bza' can/ mi mgo'i phreng ba sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ 'khor 'chi bdag nag po rang 'dra ba brgyad kyis bskor ba/ gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas dkar mo nyi zla dang bdud kyi rgyal po phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bh+yoḥ che zhes chen mo gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srog bdag bdud kyi rgyal po dang / /'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyang / /dngos grub stsol phyir gshegs su gsol/ /hūm̐ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /bdag nyid chen mo shwa na bse mo'i tshogs/ /dpal gyi pho nya mthu rtsal rdzu 'phrul can/ /dam tshig dbang gi gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/

/oṃ badz+ra shin+taṃ pad+ma kurti daṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba ma ra kṛṣ+ṇa ka pā la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dha ti ma ma shrī gh+raṃ karma ka ra mā ra se na pra marta ni sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ 'dir bzhugs dam can srung ma'i tshogs/ /de dag kun la rab gus pas/ /mchod cing bstod de brtan bzhugs te/ /dges pa'i dngos grub kun stsol cig /sngon gyi dam bca' rjes dran pas/ /dam tshig de las ma 'da' bar/ /rnal 'byor bdag gis gang bcol ba'i/ /las rnams ma lus 'dir sgrubs cig /sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭhan+tu/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ badz+ra shin+taṃd pad+ma kurtiṃ bh+yoḥ oṃ sarba mā ra kṛṣ+ṇa kā pā sa la mā la dha ra sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba sha truṃ bigh+nan mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kī li nas༞ sa pa ri wā ra bar gong bzhin gyi rjes su/ i daṃ ba liṃ bhuñdza kha kha khā hi khā hi sogs lan gsum mam lnga yis gtor ma 'bul/ oṃ a/ pā d+yaṃ/ dhu paṃ/ ā lo ke gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ shin+taṃ ku ru/ puṣ+ṭaṃ ku ru/ wa shaṃ ku ru ma hā pañtsa a mṛ ta khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ dkar mo nyi zla bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ bdag nyid ma bzhi/ shwa na ma bzhi/ sa bdag ma bzhi/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du mchod pa dam pa 'bul lo/ /ces pas nang mchod phul nas/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang / bla ma rnams kyi sku tshe dang mdzad pa phrin las kyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams bsam don chos ldan yid bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod/ bstod pa ni/ che zhes chen mo gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /srid gsum bdag tu mdzad la bstod/ /g.yu yi ral pa rab mdzes shing /

/'jol ber dar dkar na bza' gsol/ /ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams/ /khams gsum dbang du sdud la bstod/ /mkha' 'gro bye ba'i gtso mo khyod/ /dus gsum gzigs pa'i 'dod dgu ster/ /'phrin las rnam bzhis don mdzad pas/ /yum mchog bdud 'dul khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ bdud po ma rung gshin rje'i gzugs/ /mdog nag khams gsum zil gyis gnon/ /lha sogs dmag 'gyed bing yang thogs/ /mi mgo'i phreng 'dzin bdud rgyal bstod/ /dar nag gos gyon sbrul gyis brgyan/ /rab tu rngams pa'i cha lugs can/ /bdud rta nag po chibs su byas/ /bdud rgyal mgon po khyod la bstod/ /khyod bzhin bdud rta'i kha phyir phyogs/ /de yi log 'dren tshar gcod cing / /nye bar bstan la dngos grub stsol/ /bstan srung khyod la yang dag bstod/ /lcam dral bka' yi nye 'khor ba'i/ /snang dang srid pa'i 'khor mang po/ /sna tshogs gzugs 'dzin las kun sgrub/ /dam can srung ma rnams la bstod/ /sman raka gtor ma phud tshogs dang / /mchod sprin rgya mtsho mtha' yas pas/ /dam can srung ma 'khor bcas mchod/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ che zhes chen mo gsang ba'i gzugs/ /thig le sbyor ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng can/ /gru gsum 'bar ba'i spyan gcig ma/ /g.yu yi ral pas srid gsum sgrol/ /dbang gi phyag mdzes pad+ma bsnams/ /rno dkar mche bas skye 'gro gso/ /bdud kyi zhabs pas mu stegs sgrol/ /thig le gsang ba'i yum gcig ma/ /dwangs ma tshe yi longs spyod drongs/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /ces pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi bden pa yis/ /mkha' 'gro ni nam mkha' bzhin/ /sgra snyan ni kun la khyab/ /nyid sku ni lhun po bzhin/ /'phrin las la thogs mi mnga'/ /khyod la ni mthun pa'i rdzas/ /mang po yis mngon par mchod/ /nyams chag gi thugs dam bskang /

/las bzhi yi yum gcig dang / /drag po yi bdud rgyal la/ /gzugs sgra dri ro dang bcas/ /reg bya sogs mchod pas mchod/ /dbyings las ni ma g.yos kyang / /thugs rje yis bdag kun skyongs/ /khams gsum la dbang mdzad pas/ /bcol pa'i ni phrin las sgrubs/ /srid zhi yi bde legs rnams/ /'byung ba yi bstan pa skyongs/ /gdung gsob kyi rnal 'byor pa/ /'khor bcas la dngos grub stsol/ /dkar mo nyi zla stong gi thod pa'i phreng ba can/ ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung ba dang / bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang / bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du sgrub pa dang / bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ mthu chen bdud 'dul/ pha rol phyin bcu'i mnga' bdag sa bcu'i mnga' bdag rnal 'byor dgra lha/ rigs 'dzin srung ma/ ded dpon chen po/ lha ma yin gyi g.yul tshogs zlog byed/ lha dmag dkar po dbugs 'byin/ bdud spu gri nag po/ rdo rje dur khrod/ rdo rje thod phreng dang bcas pa rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyong / rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob rgyu 'byor yon bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi 'gal rkyen phyi nang gi bar chad thams cad srungs/ mthun rkyen tshe dang bsod nams/ dpal dang 'byor pa/ 'khor dang longs spyod snyan grags yon tan thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang / bsam pa'i don thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzod/ gzhan yang sdang byed dgra bo 'khor dang bcas pa'i lus ngag yid gsum rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod cig mdor na zhi rgyas dbang dang / mngon spyod kyi phrin las gang bcol ba thams cad myur du sgrubs shig de nas bzlog bskul bya ba ni/ hūm̐ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu rab tu 'bar ba'i dbus/ /gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor nas/

/khro bo'i rgyal po khrag 'thung he ru ka /thugs dam dus la babs so dbyings las bzhengs/ /ma rungs 'dul phyir drag po'i skur bstan nas/ /sngags 'chang rig 'dzin sgrub po bdag cag la/ /sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dpal bskyed nas/ /sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs rnams bzlog pa dang / /rkyen ngan bar gcod zhi bar byin gyis rlobs/ /hūm̐ yab gcig dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /dpal gyi yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /yab yum thabs dang shes rab rol pa las/ /phyogs bcur khro bo'i tshogs rnams spros pa ni/ /steng phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /hūm̐ mdzad sgra 'byin phag dang rmig bu'i mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /gza' dang rgyu skar gnod pa thams cad bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad bsgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /shar phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /rnam rgyal sgeg mo stag dang bya rgod mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab/ /shar phyogs dri za'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /me mtshams 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /dbyug sngon sder mo g.yag dang bya rog mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi༞ /me mtshams me lha'i gnod pa thams cad bzlog /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /lho phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /gshin rje dur khrod sha ba 'ug pa'i mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs༞ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i gnod pa༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /lho nub 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /mi g.yo gtun khung gzig dang khwa ta'i mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs༞ /lho nub srin po'i gnod tshogs༞

/bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /nub phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /rta mgrin gtum mo byi la pu shud mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /nub phyogs chu lha'i gnod pa༞ /bzlog go dmar chen༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /nub byang 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /gzhan gyi mi thub mda' snying spyang khra'i mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /nub byang rlung lha'i gnod pa༞ /bzlog go dmar chen༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /byang phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /'khyil pa sgra mdzad seng ge pha waṃ mgo /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam༞ /byang phyogs gnod sbyin༞ /bzlog go dmar chen༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /byang shar 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /khams gsum gsod byed dred dang sre mong mgo /'khor bcas khyod kyi༞ /byang shar bgegs bdag༞ /bzlog go dmar chen༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /'og phyogs 'khor lo 'bar ba'i rtsibs dbus na/ /stobs chen rigs byed dom dang byi la'i mgo /'khor bcas khyed༞ /'og phyogs sa bdag༞ /bzlog go dmar chen༞ /bsgyur ro ltas ngan༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /dgug gzhug bcings mnyes las la dbang byed pa'i/ /gnod sbyin 'jigs pa bdud rtsi gsod byed ma/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad bsgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /las bzhi'i phrin las ma lus sgrub mdzad pa'i/ /phur pa sras kyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /gdug pa 'dul ba'i pho nyar khas blangs pa/

/dregs pa dbang phyug nyi shu rtsa brgyad ma/ /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs༞ /dgra bgegs gnod pa༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes dam nyams sgrol/ /drag gtum mi bzad dam can bcu gnyis po/ /'khor bcas khyod kyi thugs༞ /dgra bgegs gnod pa༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /bzlog bsgyur༞ /sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /chos skyong mgon po lcam dral lha tshogs kun/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi༞ /dgra bgegs gnod pa༞ /bzlog go༞ /bsgyur ro༞ /bzlogs bsgyur༞ /hūm̐ phyogs skyong bcu dang gza' dang rgyu skar dang / /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa pho mo'i tshogs/ /'khor bcas khyed kyi thugs dam dus la babs/ /dgra bgegs gnod pa thams cad bzlog tu gsol/ /bzlog go dmar chen gtor ma 'di yis bzlog /bsgyur ro ltas ngan cho 'phrul thams cad bsgyur/ /bzlog bsgyur bcol pa'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /hūm̐ dpal chen bka' sdod mthu bo che/ /bdud mgon nag po las la bzhengs/ /bzlog pa'i dmag sna da mdzod cig /sde brgyad yongs kyi dmag dpon mdzod/ /bdud rgyal thod pa'i phreng ba can/ /dam can srung ma'i dmag sna drongs/ /g.yas na dregs pa pho brgyud tshogs/ /dmag la chos shig dgra la bh+yo/ /g.yon na dregs pa mo brgyud tshogs/ /dmag la chos shig dgra la bh+yo/ /lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs/ /dmag la chos shig dgra la bh+yo/ /nga ni khrag 'thung he ru ka /thams cad nga yi bka' la nyon/ /chos shig bzlog pa'i dmag la chos/ /dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon 'phyor/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/ /ngan pa bzlog la rtsub mo bsgyur/ /mi mthun bdud bgegs bar chad rnams/ /thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la bh+yo/ /bzlog go bsgyur ro thod phreng can/ /dus la bab bo sa mā ya/ /dus la bab bo mthu ma chung / /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/

/bh+yoḥbadag nyid chen mo'i dus la babs/ /che zhes dpal ldan re ma ṭi/ /che zhes dpal ldan re ma ṭa/ /che zhes dpal ldan re ma dza/ /che zhes dpal ldan re ma dzu/ /bdag nyid chen mo mched bzhi yang / /sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa la/ /khrag 'thung rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /dregs pa ru tra btul ba'i tshe/ /srog snying phul zhing dam la btags/ /bar du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /yang le shod kyi brag phug tu/ /dam la btags shing las gnyer gtad/ /khas blangs dam bca' ji bzhin du/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'dis bzhes la/ /gtad do gnyer ro dam can ma/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ shwa na mu kha'i dus la babs/ /lcags kyi spyang mo mgo dgu la/ /mi mo spyang ki'i gdong can zhon/ /gser gyi 'phar ba lce brgyad la/ /mi mo 'phar ba'i gdong can zhon/ /zangs kyi wa mo rkang gsum la/ /mi mo wa yi gdong can zhon/ /g.yu yi khyi mo ral can la/ /mi mo khyi yi gdong can zhon/ /dam can shwa na mu kha bzhi/ /sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa la/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /dregs pa ru tra btul ba'i tshe/ /srog snying phul zhing dam la btags/ /bar du pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /g.ya' ri gong gi brag phug tu/ /dam la btags shing las gnyer gtad/ /khas blangs dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /da lta rnal 'byor bdag gis bskul/ /rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ /gtad do gnyer ro dam can ma/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /bh+yoḥ sa bdag chen mo'i dus la babs/ /ci phyin rdo rje mthu mo che/ /ya phyin rdo rje rtsal mo che/ /bse phyin rdo rje rdzu 'phrul che/ /phag phyin rdo rje stobs mo che/ /dam can bse yi lha mo bzhi/ /sngon tshe 'das dus bskal pa la/ /dpal chen rdo rje༞ /dregs pa༞ /srog snying phul༞ /bar du pad+ma༞ /rgya gar dur khrod so sa dang / /chu mig byang chub ri sul yang / /dam la༞

/khas blangs༞ /da lta rnal 'byor༞ /rgyan gyi༞ /gtad do gnyer ro dam can ma/ /rang 'khor srung ma'i gnyer mdzod cig /bskul lo rbad do mthu ma chung / /gang la dmigs pa rdul du rlog /bcol lo phrin las las la bcol/ /bcol ba'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ /de nas/ chos skyong rnams la slar yang bstod pa ni/ bh+yo dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla ni/ /dar dkar 'jol ber sku la gsol/ /ri rab gling bzhi phyag na bsnams/ /skye 'gro gso mdzad khyod la bstod/ /hūm̐ dpal chen bka'i pho nya ni/ /rlung gi shugs can bdud rta'i steng / /mdog nag ru mtshon thod phreng can/ /bdud rgyal nag po khyed la bstod/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs bdag nyid ma/ /shwa na mu kha'i bse mo bzhi/ /phur srung rnams la bstod par bgyi/ /mdun du tshogs ci 'byor pa bshams/ byin rlabs ni/ mes tshogs kyi snod la reg pas zhes dang / 'og gi tshogs dang 'dres pas kha dog dri ro zhes 'don pa bsgyur ba ma gtogs gong sman rag gi skabs bzhin/ oṃ ā hūm̐ lan gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs la/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan 'dren pa ni/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa'i sku/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol bar mi dmigs kyang / /thugs rje'i ngang nyid chos sku dag pa la/ /ye shes sgyu mar rol te gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ e h+ya h+ye bhā ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ra tri sh+ya ho/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ e a ra li hriṃ hriṃ/ zhes brjod cing / rang 'dra'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs la/ gzugs kyi mchod pa khyad par che/ /sgra yi mchod pa yid 'ong ldan/ /dri yi mchod pa tshim pas mchod/ /ro yi mchod pa bde mchog ldan/ /reg bya'i mchod pa bla na med/ /mchod pa rnam pa lnga rnams kyis/ /phyogs bcu nam mkha'i khams bkang nas/ /dkyil 'khor kun la rgyas par 'bul/ /bla med mchog gi sogs/ nas/ ci bder bzhes su gsol/

/zhes pa'i bar dang / dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa nas/ khā hi khā hi/ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing dbul lo/ /bshags pas mchod pa ni/ lus kyis sdig pa bgyis pa mngon sum bgyis/ /ngag gis tshig 'khyal smras pa ngag tu brjod/ /sems kyis blo nor log pa bsam la sogs/ /'dod khro gti mug dbang gis nongs bgyis pa/ /bkra ba'i lha tshogs khyod la bzod par gsol/ /bzod par gsol lo tshangs pa stsal du gsol/ /ye shes lha la rtog pa mi mnga' yang / /de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i dam can rnams/ /mi yi skyon mthong tsam na brlag par mdzod/ /nyams chag 'gal 'khrul ci mchis mthol lo bshags/ /mthol bshags tshangs pa'i dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ces brjod pa ni tshogs kyi mchod pa'o/ /liṅga rnams gu gul gyi bdug la/ rang gi mdun du bzhag rang nyid rdor dril thogs nas/ dgug gzhug 'og nas 'byung ba ltar lan gsum tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba dang bcas byas la/ liṅga'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje dang ri rab kyis mnan la/ thar pa med par bsams la liṅga'i ske la btags pa'i phur pa gtor ma la btsugs te bzhag rang gi snying kha nas 'od 'phros pas yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi rgyud bskul nas/ so so'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer mang po spros te/ gtor ma dang thun rdzas rnams la phog pas/ dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam la/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzad cig /de bzhin du 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro/ /pad+ma gsung༞ /yang dag thugs༞ /bdud rtsi yon tan༞ /phrin las phur bu༞ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yi/ /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis/ /'jigs byed khro bo bcu po yis/ /rdo rje khro mo bcu rnams kyis/ /sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu yis/ /ye shes sgo ma bzhi po yis/ /sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga yis/ /dam can shwa na bcu gnyis kyis/

/bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi yis/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas kyis/ /rig 'dzin rtsal chen 'khor bcas kyis/ /zor chen rdzas kyi mthu bskyed la/ /dgra bgegs srog la mnga' mdzod cig /bdag gi gtor zor gnyen po 'di/ /rig 'dzin bla mas byin gyis brlabs/ /yi dam mkha' 'gro'i nus pa bskyed/ /dam can srung mas drag por bsgrub/ /sdang byed dgra la 'phen pa'i zor/ /gnod byed bgegs la 'phen pa'i zor/ /gdug can thal bar rlog pa'i zor/ /dam nyams rtsad nas gcod pa'i zor/ /dgra bo'i rigs rgyud gcod pa'i zor/ /sde brgyad dmag dpung bskyed pa'i zor/ /zor chen sogs༞ dam can bka' bsdod mthu ma chung / /pho nya las mkhan rtsal ma zhan/ /bh+yo bh+yoḥsdang ba'i dgra la bh+yoḥ /bh+yoḥbh+yoḥganod pa'i bgegs la bh+yo/ /zhes bskul nas gtso bo'i sngags dang / khro bo bcu/ sgo ma bzhi/ gzhi snying gcig tu sgril ba'i sngags dang / thun sngags 'di yang bzlas te/ suṃ trig rak+ṣa bh+yoḥ thib thib tsakra bh+yoḥ snying ga rag dun tri bh+yoḥ tri na shig se na gtubs/ kha rag rbad/ dum bu bh+yoḥ badz+ra ra ti rak+ṣa tsa turmā ra ya hūm̐/ gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams ci rigs brjod/ mjug gi cho ga dngos grub blang ba ni/ ye shes lnga ldan rigs lnga bde bar gshegs/ /sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis/ /'khor lo rab bskor zhi khro'i skur ston pa/ /thugs dam bzhin du bdag la brtser dgongs nas/ /drag po'i stobs kyis dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /ces brjod la mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub stsal bar bsam mo/ /yig brgya lan gsum gyi mthar/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs nas/ de kun bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i sogs nas/ lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol zhes pa'i bar dang / phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sogs dang /

su pra tiṣ+ṭha'i bar spyi dang mthun par brjod cing rten yod pa la brten bzhugs bya rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyod kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /sogs nas/ slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing / mdun gyi dkyil 'khor dang dam can rnams gshegs su gsol/ zhag sgrub byed na nyin dang po rnams la mi dgos 'phen zin pa'i rjes chog la bya'o/ /de nas/ rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la phog pas/ 'od kyi rnam par bsdus/ bsrung ba'i 'khor lor thim/ dur khrod brgyad gzhal yas khang la/ de dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ de gtso bo yab yum la/ yum yab la thim zhing rang gtso bo'i nga rgyal gyis spyod lam thams cad rjes su spyad par bya'o/ /bdag nyid bsrung ba ni/ oṃ shrī badz+ra ku mā ra kro dha rak+ṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas rang gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ oṃ badz+ra ka ba tse hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus la rdo rje'i go gyon pas bar chad kyis mi tshugs par bsam mo/ /drug pa bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis mtha' yas sems can kun/ /bdud las rnam rgyal bar chad kun bcom nas/ /rdo rje gzhon nu mya ngan 'das pa yi/ /'bras bu byang chub nges par 'grub gyur cig /ces brjod/ shis pa brjod pa ni/ hūm̐ skye med chos sku'i rang bzhin rnam dag las/ /thugs dam dbang gis gzugs kyi skur sprul pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi/ /skye shi med pa'i don gyi bkra shis shog /sngags 'chang grags blos pas mdzad pa'i phur 'bring las go gyon rjes bsngo ba gsungs/ phur 'bring yig cha gzhan du go gyon rjes rang bzhin sems kyi sogs rtag chad mtha' gsal bsngo ba rnams gsungs shing phyag len la'ang mdzad/ de bzhin bkra shis kyang sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin bshad pa ltar phyag len la mdzad do/ /ces sogs bkra shis rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar la bya'o/
