/de lta bu'i tshul gyis zhag bdun la sogs pa bsgrub nas/ gsum pa rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa ni/ gnas yo byin brlabs nas/ tshogs bshags rdzogs pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ bzlog pa dang bskul rnams 'og tu bya bas 'dir ma dgos/ sngon 'gro yang sbrel so drug bya ba/ dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las byas nas ling ro 'bul ba/ bzlog pa zor gyi las bstan pa'o/ /dang po la drug gser skyems/ gtor ma/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ lha srung spyan drangs shing ༈ bdag nyid lhar gsal ba phur pa sras mchog tu gsal ba/ liṅga gzas pa sogs dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba/ dgug gzhug bya ba/ gsal ba gsum dang gdengs gsum gsal gdab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/༈ gnyen po lha'i gdengs/ mgo gnon sngags kyi gdengs/ rtogs pa lta ba'i gdengs/ ma nyes ting nge 'dzin sogs drug bya ba'o/ /dang po ni/ ji ltar bde ba'i sar mi'i g.yang gzhi'i khar/ 'brub khung gru gsum nag po me ris dang bcas pa bris pa'i dbus su liṅga rnams bzhag rang gi g.yas su gu gul/ yungs dkar nag sngo mar gyi zhags pa/ dug khrag sbyar ba'i thun/ lcags zangs rdo phye rnams dang / g.yon du gdab phur rnams dang / ral gri/ tho ba/ de dag la ngar bskyed pa'i sman phud dang / rak+ta cung zad dang / rdo rje dril bu rnams bsham/ sgrub pa po rnams he ru ka'i chas su zhugs la/ gser skyems gtsang ma khyer nas/ byin brlabs gong bzhin byas la/ bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams mchod/ /khyad par phur pa'i lha tshogs mchod/ /mi mngon dbyings nas thugs rje yis/ /nyer dgongs byin rlabs dpa' bskyed la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba dang / /phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ /slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nas/ /phur pa'i srung mar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /dam can rgya mtsho phud kyis mchod/

/gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /phyi nang bar chad mi 'byung zhing / /grub gnyis༞ /bstan pa srung mdzad kun gyi gtso/ /dpal ldan nag po lcam dral dang / /zhing skyong dbang phyug gdong bzhi sogs/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs bcas kun/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba sogs/ /༞༞༞༞ /phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / /gnas bdag kun dang yul bdag kun/ /gser skyems gtsang mas tshims byas nas/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /byer dang 'khu ldog ma mdzad par/ /sdong grogs gnyen po ci nus mdzod/ /sa yi phyogs ni 'di nyid na/ /sa'am mkha' la 'khod pa yi/ /lha klu gnod sbyin dri za dang / /'byung po mang po gang 'khod pa/ /thams cad phud kyis tshims gyur nas/ /gdug pa'i dgra bgegs bsgral ba la/ /ru nga phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /sdong grogs gnyen po ci nus mdzod/ /lha yi phyag rgya mi bzod cing / /byer dang 'khu ldog byed pa rnams/ /gser skyems gtsang mas tshims byas nas/ /ci bde bar ni gzhan du dengs/ /gnyis pa phur kha bsgyur ba ni/ tshe 'dzin gyi dbyangs dang / rin po che'i 'dur 'chams bya zhing / do nub kyi phur kha gnyen po 'di/ /steng gi lha la mi ston no/ /lha gshegs gangs dkar rtse la gshegs/ /phur lam gnyen po da phyes cig /de bzhin du tshig gong 'og rnams gong dang 'dra ba la/ bar gyi btsan la mi ston no/ /btsan gshegs brag dmar logs la gshegs/ /'og gi klu la༞ /klu gshegs rgya mtsho'i gting la gshegs/ /do nub kyi phur kha gnyen po 'di/ /yas kyi bdud g.yos cig la ston/ /mas kyi sri langs cig la ston/ /pha tshan rgya 'dre can༞ /ma bu'i byur 'dre can༞ /yul mi gdong 'dre can la༞ /sdang dgra gnod pa'i bgegs la༞ /phung sri'i snying ga'i dkyil du༞ /byur sri'i klad pa'i dkyil༞ /nyams pa'i snying kha'i dkyil du༞ /rmi lam ngan sdig byed la ston/

/gsum pa lha srung spyan drangs dgug gzhug byed pa ni/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya bcas la/ e raṃ e raṃ dz+wa la raṃ/ dzaḥ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang / sangs rgyas༞ chos kyi༞ dge 'dun༞ 'jam dpal sku/ pad+ma gsung / yang dag thugs/ bdud rtsi yon tan/ phrin las phur pa/ ma mo rbod gtong / dmod pa drag sngags/ 'jig rten mchod bstod/ 'dus pa mdo/ sgyu 'phrul rgyan/ 'chi med tshe/ lhun grub rig 'dzin/ snying po phyag rgya/ gsang sngags/ rig sngags/ gzungs sngags kyi lha tshogs rnams kyi༞ bka' bsdod chos skyong / ma mo mkha' 'gro/ dam can rgya mtsho/ rig 'dzin rnal 'byor/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i bka' bden pa dang / bden pa yang dag pa dang / bden pa chen po'i byin gyis rlabs kyis/ spyir bstan pa'i spyi dgra/ bla ma'i sku dgra/ dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra/ sems can yongs la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa dang / khyad par du yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i gzugs can gyi dgra/ gzugs med kyi bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad skad cig thang cig yud tsam la gzugs dang liṅga 'di nyid la mchis par gyur cig ces dang / kī la ya'i mthar khug cig phob cig ṇi ya ma dzaḥ tri ya ma dzaḥ zhes dang / sgo ma bzhi'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe ho/ zhes dang dril bu gsil la/ sarba sha trun/ nā sha ya/ dzaṃ bhā ya/ stam+bha ya/ mo ha ya/ ban+dha ya mā ra ya/ zhes brjod pa gsum byas pa'i mthar/ 'dod rgyal gyi phyag rgya las/ mdzub mos dgug pa'i stangs ka byas la pañtsa kan+dhaṃ de wa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ phung po lnga'i lha khug khams bco brgyad kyi lha khug ༈ dhā ru aṣ+ṭa da sha de wa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ skye mched bcu gnyis kyi lha khug༈ dwe da sha ya tā nan de wa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ

mdor na bsrung skyabs byed pa'i lha 'dir khug ces so/༈ sarba de wa rak+ṣa ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ ces brjod cing / sems kyis rang gi snying ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mdun gyi liṅga dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba'i snying kar phog pas kho la srung skyob byed pa'i lha dang / srung ma thams cad rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnam par byung ste/ rang la thim pas kho srung skyob dang bral zhing / bdag nyid gzi brjid rgyas par bsam pa ni tshe srog ye shes su bsgyur ba zhes bya ba'o/ /de nas rnga brdung 'dur dbyangs dang bcas pas/ bcom ldan dpal chen he ru ka /sprul pa yang sprul bka' bsdod dang / /pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs bzhugs shing byin phob la/ /dam sri gdug pa'i dgra dang bgegs/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la 'da' byed cing / /rnal 'byor sku la bsdo ba rnams/ /rgyal bas bsgral bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /gnas pa'i yul nas yud tsam gyis/ /rten dang phrol la khrid la shog /phyogs las zhes pa'ang snang / /rgyab dang phrol la khrid la shog /sa gzhi yan chod thog la shog /bdun brgyud tshun chad khug la shog /ma thog myur du khug la shog /dril bu drag dkrol ngos rdo rje g.yab pa gsum dang hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya mdzub mo gug pa gsum bya/༈ oṃ aṅku sha dzaḥdzaḥ bzhi pa gsal ba gsum dang / gdengs gsum gsal gdab cing nga rgyal bskyed pa ni/ bde ba'i brjid dbyangs dang / nor bu'i bskor 'chams bya zhing / hūm̐ nga ni rdo rje gzhon nu yin/ /thugs nang 'bar ba'i srog kyang zhugs/ /tshigs brgyad spyi bo rkang mthil rnams/ /khro bo khro mo'i bdag nyid gnas/ /dang po rang lhar gsal ba'i/༈ phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /nyi khri chig stong skra tshogs dang / /bye ba khrag khrig ba spu'i tshogs/ /khro rgyal rang 'dras gtams par gyur/ /khro bo khro mo phra men dang /༈ gnyen po lha'i gdengs ni/

/sgo ma sras mchog phur bu'i tshogs/ /dam can rgya mtsho tshogs bcas rnams/ /dpal dang gzi brjid 'bar bar bzhugs/ /snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun/༈ rtogs pa lta ba'i gdengs ni/ /ma lus khro rgyal nyid kyi ngang / /oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya ༈ mgo gnon sngags kyi gdengs ni/ sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ phur pa sras mchog tu gsal gdab pa ni/༈ dip+ta tsakra phur bu'i lha/ /zhes pa nas/ gnod byed bgegs la smos ci dgos/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ liṅga bsgral yul gzas pa po/༈ liṅga gzas pa po gsal ba ni/ /shin tu rid cing yan lag phra/ /mi sdug bzhin can tshar bcad phyir/ /mngon sum nyid du gsal bar gyur/ /lnga pa ma nyes pa'i dpang gzugs pa ni/ rdo rje'i mtsher dbyangs dang / dpag bsam gyi 'jol 'chams bya zhing / rgyud gsum bla ma rig 'dzin tshogs/ /yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams dang / /khyad par phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams/ /bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra ste/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa'i spyi dgra yin/ /dam tshig can gyi sdang dgra lags/ /sems can yongs la gnod 'tshe byas/ /mtshams med lnga dang nye ba bsags/ /nyams pa bdun dang bzhi bcu tshang /༈ srog don bka' dam las las nyams/ mchin ma 'dod pas rnams dang bdun/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas dpa' bo dang / /rdo rje sems dpa' bkrongs pa ste/ /'di ste sdig pa chen po can/ /mnar med 'gro ba'i bdag nyid yin/ /bdag nyid snying rje cher bskyed nas/ /'jig rten rten 'brel nor rdzas dang / /'dus byas zas kyi longs spyod sbyin/ /sna tshogs thabs kyis khrid byas nas/ /las ngan 'di la bzlog cig ces/ /yang yang gsal yang bzlog ma nyan/ /des na gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /re zhig thugs kyis btang bar 'tshal/ /bdag gis ma nyes ma yo zhing / /mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan pas/

/de ltar legs par gzung du gsol/ /chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang / /dam can rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas/ /snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dang /༈ 'dre zer ba dang 'dug phyogs skyong gzhi bdag bdag la dgongs/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /bla ma'i sku la 'khu 'khu ba/ /rgyal ba'i bka' la 'gom 'gom pa/ /rnal 'byor sku la bsdo bsdo ba/ /bdag kyang 'phags pa rab mchod cing / /gzhan don ci nus bgyis bsam pas/ /dgra bgegs 'di yi ma ster ro/ /spros bral rang bzhin dag pa'i klong / /dbyings kyi thig le bsgom snyam pas/ /bar chad rkyen 'dis ma ster ro/ /bdag gis cung zad ma nyes shing / /rnam pa kun tu ma yo bas/ /de ltar mkhyen par mdzad nas kyang / /mthu stobs bskyed pa'i cho ga mdzod/ /lha dang gnyis su med par bsgoms/ /dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i grogs mdzod cig /drug pa rdzas dmod mo ting nge 'dzin sogs drug bya ba la/ rgyud las/ lha phral gnas nas gug pa dang / /rnam shes gzugs bstim byad du gzhug /smyor gzhug rdul du rlog pa dang / /sha khrag zhal du bstabs nas dgyes/ /'di drug shes na las rnams grub/ /ces gsungs pas/ dang po lha dang phral ba/ gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa/ gsum pa byad du gzhug pa/ bzhi pa smyo ru gzhug pa/ lnga pa rdul du brlog pa/ drug pa zhal du bstabs pa'o/ /de re re la drug drug ste/ bsags par bya ba'i rdzas drug bsam pa mthar phyin pa'i dmod mo drug dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin drug bskyed par bya ba'i lha drug sbas pa'i 'phyong drug gab pa'i sngags drug rnams las/ dang po ni/ rdzas gu gul gnyis pa dmod mo ni/ na mo bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu dang / /yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma/ /ye shes sprul pa'i khro bo bcu/ /rdo rje dbyings kyi khro mo bcu/ /thabs kyi rang bzhin mche ba can/ /shes rab rang bzhin gshog pa can/

/bdag nyid shwa na sa bdag sogs/ /phur pa'i lha tshogs 'khor bcas kyis/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /chos kyi srung ma dang phrol cig /bon gyi lha sa dang phrol cig /skye bo'i dgra lha dang phrol cig /pho lha yul lha srog lha dang / /bskyed pa'i lha bzhi 'go ba yi/ /lha lnga dbang thang lha drug dang / /skyob pa'i lha kun dang phrol cig /brten pa'i sa dang gnas pa'i yul/ /kun dang myur ba nyid du phrol/ /gsum pa dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ ra mda' byed pa'i btson bzhin gyur/ /zhes brjod/ bzhi pa bskyed par bya ba'i lha ni/ sgo ma dang sras mchog la sogs pa rnams kyis gu gul gyis bdug par bsam mo/ /lnga pa sbas pa'i 'phyong ni/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs nas/ bsgral bar bya ba'i dus ma babs kyi bar dang / rdo rje gsang ba'i bka' lung gis nas/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed/ /gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /sdigs shig grogs dang dbye bar gyis/ /drug pa gab pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho/ mu haṃ gha tā ya/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ha sa ya ra/ ha sa ya ra shrī gh+raṃ karta ya ma ra se na pra mar+dha ni sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ gnyis pa gzugs la dbab pa la drug gi dang po rdzas yungs dkar sogs/ gnyis pa bsam pa mthar phyin pa'i dmod mo ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di phob cig gzugs la phob/ /ri mo la phob liṅga dang / /gnyis su med pa nyid du gyis/ /gsum pa dmigs pa gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i ting nge 'dzin ni/ bye mar char babs pa bzhin du 'gyur/ bzhi pa skyed par byed pa'i lha ni/ sras mchog sogs kyi thun thogs par bsam pa'o/ /lnga pa bskul tshig dam tshig chen po sogs nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /phob cig rnam par gzir bar gyis/ /drug pa gab pa'i sngags ni/ thog mtha' gnyis gong bzhin la/

gnod byed dgra bgegs ā be sha ya/ ā be sha ya/ gsum pa byad du gzhug pa la/ dang po rdzas sngo dmar gyi zhags pa/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di zungs shig rab chings shig /lus dang yan lag kun sdoms shig /gru gu bzhin du rab sgongs shig /gsum pa ni/ lcags kyis bcings pa'i btson bzhin gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog zhags pa thogs par bsgom/ /lnga pa ni/ dam tshig chen po'i sogs nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /zungs shig chings shig rnam par sdom/ /drug pa gnod byed dgra bgegs shī kring a na ya sogs/ bzhi pa smyo ru gzhug pa la/ dang po rdzas gtor ma/༈ dug thun zhes pa'ang snang / gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di smyor chug myos su chug /gsum pa ni/ dbang med smra zhing lab par gyur/ /bzhi pa/ sras mchog sogs dug thun thogs par bsgom/ lnga pa/ dam tshig chen po nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /ring nas khug las smra ru chug /drug pa ni/ gnod byed dgra bgegs dz+wa la pā ya dz+wa la pā ya sogs/ lnga pa/ rdul du rlog pa la/ dang po ni/ lcags zangs rdo phye/ gnyis pa/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyi/ /dgra 'di med brlag phung bar gyis/ /gsum pa ni/ thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlag par gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog sogs/ lcags zangs kyi thun thogs par bsgom pa'o/ /lnga pa/ dam tshig chen po nas/ gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /lus sems rdul phran bzhin du rlog /drug pa ni/ gnod byed dgra bgegs ta thā ya ta thā ya sogs/ drug pa zhal du bstabs pa la/ dang po rdzas ling ro/ gnyis pa ni/ khro rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas kyis/ /dgra 'di bzhes rol zhal du gsol/ gsum pa ni/ dgra bgegs zhal du bstabs par gyur/ /bzhi pa ni/ sras mchog ling ro thogs pa/ lnga pa/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs nas/ nga yi bka' las 'da' ma byed kyi bar dang /

gdug cing gtum pa'i dgra bgegs 'di/ /badz+ra yak+ṣa kro dhā kha hi/ drug pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mo hi gha tā ya/ gnod byed dgra bgegs bi da ya bi da ya/ shrī gh+raṃ karta ya/ mā ra se na pra mar+dha ni sarba bigh+nan bhan+dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces bya'o/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las bstan pa la drug kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba/ nyon mongs pa'i skye ba'i sgo lnga dag par bsgral ba/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dag par bsgral ba/ ma bdud kyi dmod mos bsgral ba/ dge sdig cha mnyam ste bsgral ba'o/ /dang po ni gong bzhin dgug gzhug lan gcig byas la/ kun gzhi rtsad bcad de bsgral ba la/ dam tshig chen po'i dus la babs/ /zhes pa nas/ sdug bsngal nyams su myong bar mdzod/ /ces pa'i bar brjod la/ de nas kun gzhi'i gnas lugs gsal gdab pa ni/ liṅga de dgra bgegs dngos su gsal ba'i snying kar rtsa bzhi ni chos nyid rang byung gi rtsa/ gnyis med ye shes kyi rtsa/ glo bur rgyud 'dzin gyi rtsa/ skyon yon dbang po dwangs byed kyi rtsa bzhi bsdoms pa'i dbus su sha'i dwangs ma byi'u lan pa'i mgo tsam gyi nang du/ khrag gi dwangs ma mtshal lcog la lta bu/ de'i nang du rtsa'i dwangs ma dar dkar gyi skud pa lta bus dril nas dbugs kyi dwangs ma drod kyi rnam par gnas shing / de'i nang du 'od kyi dwangs ma nya'i mig tsam gyi dbus su/ tshe'i rten sdom gyi rgya lta bus dril nas rnam par shes pa a dkar po'i rnam par gnas pa ni 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi'o/ /de ltar bsam nas gtso bo'i phur pa rang gi klad la bskor bas sku'i lha tshogs 'dus par bsam la/ de bzhin du mgrin pa dang / snying kar bsgril bas gsung dang thugs kyi lha tshogs nam mkha' gang bar spyan drangs bar bsam/ de nas khrus lung la/ khams gsum sems can gyi khrus lung / bdag rnal 'byor pa'i khrus lung / liṅga gzas pa po'i khrus lung dang gsum las/
